meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会记录每次分发、扫描、解析与卡片生成事件，按 trace_id 串成可追溯证据链并写入向量索引，同时提供按 trace_id、时间窗、官署维度的检索接口。
howto.when: 当你构建多智能体系统、需要全链路可观测与安全审计时触发；各官署在关键操作节点调用，或经事件总线异步推送时写入证据链。

say.text: 跑一下 provenance 阶段，把全链路事件写进证据链
按 trace_id 查这次分发的证据链
say.note: 返回该 trace_id 的证据链

say.text: 给我最近一小时军机处的操作事件
say.note: 按时间窗和官署维度检索

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude records every dispatch, scan, parse and card-generation event, chains them into a traceable evidence chain by trace_id, writes a vector index, and offers a query API by trace_id, time window or agency.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you build multi-agent systems needing end-to-end observability and security audit; each agency writes to the chain at key operation points or via an async event bus.

say_en.text: Run the provenance stage and write the full event chain to the evidence log
Query the evidence chain for this trace_id
say_en.note: Returns the chain for that trace_id

say_en.text: Show me agency events from the last hour
say_en.note: Searches by time window and agency
